why: A planned ask's delivery in this repository, the wide half of the team's two reviews: once every part of the plan has landed on the ask's branch, the whole is checked on the gates it reaches, then its one review is answered by the landing supervisor this repository appoints, an agent of another family than its workers, and the branch merges into main. This repository is low risk, so no step waits on the person; a place at high risk appoints no landing supervisor, and the same review waits for the person.
